# Security Policy

Contractor.AI is under active development. The only published release is
`v1.1.0-rc.1`, a release candidate for evaluation. There is no stable release
or guaranteed support window yet. Security fixes are developed against the
current `main` branch; users of older builds should upgrade after reviewing the
relevant release notes.

## Report a Vulnerability

Use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** action on the repository's Security
tab to send a private report. Do not publish an unpatched vulnerability in an
issue, discussion, or pull request.

Include the affected version or commit, impact, and a minimal reproduction that
uses synthetic data. Do not access, alter, or export another person's data, and
do not test the hosted application or third-party services without separate
authorization. Never include credentials, customer information, or personal
data in a report unless it is essential and GitHub's private form is the
approved channel.

There is no response-time SLA or coordinated-disclosure timetable. The
maintainer will review a report and may ask for clarification through GitHub's
private advisory workflow. Please allow a reasonable period for assessment and
remediation before public disclosure.

See the full [security, privacy, and incident-response policy](../docs/SECURITY.md)
for application boundaries and operational guidance.
